question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abolish
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abolish"** means to formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution. (समाप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The government decided to abolish the outdated law.
 
 
 
• **"Cancel" **refers to deciding or announcing that a planned event will not take place or that an agreement is no longer valid. (रद्द करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The meeting was cancelled due to unforeseen circumstances.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'abolish' **is **'cancel'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Assist **(मदद करना): To help or aid someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She assisted her friend in completing the project.
 
 
 
• **Subside **(शांत होना): To become less intense, violent, or severe.
 
 
• **Example: **The storm began to subside after a few hours.
 
 
 
• **Worship** (पूजा करना): The feeling or expression of reverence and adoration for a deity.
 
 
• **Example:** The community gathered to worship at the temple.
